intro: Paelon Memorial Hospital is a multi-specialist boutique hospital in Victoria Island, Lagos, established in April 2010. We are guideline and protocol driven, and we are often sought out for an honest second opinion.
founding_story:
The hospital is named for **Pa**tricia **El**ozie **On**yia — PAELON — the third and last child of our Managing Director and Founding Partner, Dr. Ngozi Onyia.

Patricia was born in Lagos on 25 May 1994 with CHARGE syndrome. In her mother's words, she was bright, cheerful, positive, loving and confident, and for her the glass was never half empty. In April 2002 she joined the Dominican Grimley School for the Deaf, when mainstream education in Lagos became too difficult. She died in her sleep on 11 November 2003, of complications from the third of five major surgeries in her short life.

"God first of all made me a Paediatrician, and then He gave me Patricia." — Dr. Ngozi Onyia, Founder and Managing Director

The hospital opened at 1221 Ahmadu Bello Way, Victoria Island, in April 2010, and carries her name. We now see patients at [three branches in Lagos](/locations), across [general practice, family healthcare, women's and children's health, fertility, endoscopy and travel medicine](/services).
mission: To provide safe, timely, evidence-based, patient-centred and technology-driven healthcare.
value_proposition:
High reliability: getting it right the first time, every time.

We provide primary, secondary and tertiary care to the highest standard, and we are careful not to overstep our bounds — much of our record rests on working with responsive colleagues in other disciplines. We care for corporate clients, health insurance and out-of-pocket patients, and a significant expatriate population, and we are listed as a service provider by the embassies of the United States and the Netherlands and by the Canadian High Commission, among others.
esg: We understand that the future is green, and we work to be part of it. We are building our ESG policy, and we have begun the process of certifying our head office as an IFC EDGE compliant zero-carbon building.
